summary.en: Films as a contact sheet: one strip per film at small scale, a frame per 4 s, each cut at its film’s length, its name to the left and its measured length at the end.
summary.zh: 把多支片排成印样：每支片一条小胶片，每 4 秒一格，按片长截断，左边写片名，末端写量出的长度。

fits: Comparing several films, renders or versions by length.
notFor: More than ten rows; anything that is not a sequence of frames.

intent.en: Lengths compared as lengths of film on one baseline.
intent.zh: 在同一基线上把时长当成胶片长度来比较。

content.en: 1–10 films: a name (≤ 12 chars / 6 字), a duration and a row strip (one 192 × 108 frame per 4 s).

fits.zh: 按时长比较多支片、多次渲染或多个版本。

notFor.zh: 多于十行；不是画格序列的东西。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
